{{Top}}
{{Quote|Although most Nothoiins now speak Basic, our first form of communication is ''sign language''.|[[Troov]]|<ref name="TheRunawayRide">{{TCWComicCite|6.50|The Runaway Ride}}</ref>}}
'''Sign language''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] that used manual communication instead of or in conjunction with sound to convey meaning by simultaneously combining hand shapes, orientation and movement of the hands, arms or body, and facial expressions to fluidly express a speaker's thoughts. Species that used a form of sign language included [[Kallidahin/Legends|Kallidahin]] and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], after being [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|captured]] and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] used sign language to relay his [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] coordinates to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. As of [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], there were 9,057 forms of sign language in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

[[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droids]] such as the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]] were limited in their ability to replicate sign language as part of their translation duties. Although their [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] bodies allowed them to translate to a certain degree, they were unable to duplicate the nuances of alien sign languages, including the subtle [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] tics used by the [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]] language.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] employed a set of standardized hand signals. Prior to their approaching the shackled [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] aboard the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|Invisible Hand]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] signaled [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] with "''approach with caution''" and "''be ready for action''."<ref name="EPIII Novelization">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>
